dogecoin.text: Wow, such bobsled: Jamaican bobsled team's trip to Sochi was funded mainly through Dogecoin, a meme-based Bitcoin alternative. #UselessFact
@rwmead: Jamaica, they have a bobsled team - whose travel fare was raised online through Dogecoin. Wow. Such bobsled.
@Karmic_Mishap There's also dogecoin, based on the meme. It's how the Jamaican bobsled team got the the Olympics.

All joking aside, between this and the April Fool’s mocking the “dogecoin to the moon” meme where they raised money for charity by claiming the Teletubbies had invented their own (fake) cryptocurrency which gets stronger with each RT, WildBrain is very clever with marketing.
